title: LaWRKY23 and LaWRKY65 negatively regulate key terpene synthases (LaTPS39) to repress sesquiterpenoid biosynthesis in Lindera aggregata.
authors: Shi, Yujie; Zhang, Shumeng; Wei, Lijuan; Xiao, Wei; Huang, Jingliang; He, Fang; Chen, Yuexie; Chen, Zhen; Zeng, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与分子实验证实LaWRKY23/65直接结合LaTPS39启动子W-box负调控倍半萜合成，虽涉及TF-DNA结合但以湿实验为主，仅分子对接为弱计算辅助，缺乏AI/物理模拟方法，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Lindera aggregata is a traditional Chinese medicine with sesquiterpenoids as key bioactive components. Although its genome has been published, the pivotal metabolic genes involved in sesquiterpenoid biosynthesis and their transcriptional regulation remain to be elucidated. This study explored sesquiterpenoid synthesis regulation via multi-omics. Headspace Solid Phase Micro-extraction Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (HS-SPME-GC-MS) identified 69 sesquiterpenoids, and the roots showed the highest accumulation. Genome-wide analysis revealed 64 terpene synthase (TPS) genes. LaTPS25, LaTPS35, and LaTPS39 were functionally validated to catalyze farnesyl pyrophosphate into sesquiterpenes, such as beta-selinene and germacrene D, through in vitro assays and molecular docking. Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) identified LaTPS39 as a hub gene regulated by three WRKY transcription factors. Yeast One-Hybrid (Y1H), Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay, and Electrophoretic Mobility Shift Assay (EMSA) confirmed that LaWRKY23 and LaWRKY65 directly bind to the W-box within the LaTPS39 promoter, potentially negatively regulating its expression and inhibiting sesquiterpenoid synthesis. These findings clarify the regulatory mechanism underlying sesquiterpenoid biosynthesis in L. aggregata.
abstract_zh: 乌药（Lindera aggregata）是一种传统中药，其关键生物活性成分为倍半萜类化合物。尽管其基因组已发表，但参与倍半萜生物合成的关键代谢基因及其转录调控机制仍有待阐明。本研究通过多组学方法探讨了倍半萜合成的调控机制。顶空固相微萃取-气相色谱-质谱联用（HS-SPME-GC-MS）鉴定出69种倍半萜类化合物，其中根部积累量最高。全基因组分析揭示了64个萜烯合酶（TPS）基因。通过体外实验和分子对接，LaTPS25、LaTPS35和LaTPS39被功能验证可催化法尼基焦磷酸生成倍半萜，如β-蛇床烯和榄香烯D。加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）将LaTPS39鉴定为由三个WRKY转录因子调控的核心基因。酵母单杂交（Y1H）、双荧光素酶报告基因检测和电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）证实，LaWRKY23和LaWRKY65直接结合LaTPS39启动子内的W-box，可能负向调控其表达并抑制倍半萜合成。这些发现阐明了乌药中倍半萜生物合成的调控机制。
